# Kefania — *Flower’s Journey* (LFØ)

[![LFØ artwork of Kefania (pink deer-pony, left) beside Flower](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2023/4/9/2953969/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/2953969)

*Artwork by LFØ, originally posted in 2023; Twibooru hosts the attributed copy.*

Kefania is the **pink deer-pony AI** in LFØ’s independent animated series *Flower’s Journey*. She is one of the artificial ponies created for Flower’s plans, alongside the unicorn Sweet Shot. Recognize her by her long icy-blue mane, dark blue-violet eyes, large deerlike ears, creamy muzzle and white dapples. In the artwork, Kefania is on the **left**, nuzzling the turquoise Flower. These are distinct characters, not alternate identities. Kefania belongs to LFØ’s own story continuity, not the official *Friendship Is Magic* continuity.

**Name and appearances.** “Kefania” is a creator-used character name, confirmed by LFØ’s [May 2024 post titled “Kefania wiggle 2”](https://www.patreon.com/posts/kefania-wiggle-2-105192507); no verified earlier name or alter ego was found. She appears in *Flower’s Journey*, episode 1, the **2025 pilot** (not a numbered G4 episode). LFØ [announced plans to continue the series](https://www.patreon.com/the1lfo/posts/flowers-journey-151724312), but I could not verify another released episode featuring her.

**Speaking and casting.** A [2025 German fandub casting page](https://www.castingcall.club/projects/flowers-journey) assigns Kefania to **Antarem**, describing her as a deer-pony and supplying the dialogue prompts “Ich kann’s machen” (“I can do it”) and “Wie machst du das?” (“How do you do that?”). Those are **dub audition lines**, not independently verified original-pilot dialogue. Her original-language voice credit could not be confirmed.

## Important moments

- **The new AI recruits** — *Flower’s Journey*, **episode 1 (pilot, 2025)**. Flower’s creation of Kefania and Sweet Shot establishes Kefania as part of her robot-pony experiment, not simply a background pony. [Creator’s full pilot](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DkUEHMfQw-I) — **scene timestamp unavailable**.
- **The deer-pony experiment** — *Flower’s Journey*, **episode 1 (pilot, 2025)**. The hybrid’s unusual design becomes a point of attention; a [contemporary viewer’s episode commentary](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/1133700/friendship-is-card-games-flowers-journey) specifically raises the question of glitches in a deer-pony hybrid. That is a viewer observation, not confirmation that a particular malfunction occurs. **Scene timestamp unavailable.**

*The pilot URL is independently referenced, but playback could not be checked here; no exact timestamps or original voice credit are asserted.*
